title: M365 & Azure Incident Response & Escalation Runbook
author_notes: Derived from a Microsoft Cloud Solution Architect (MSP) requirement: lead response on high-priority/escalated incidents across M365 and Azure; RCA + problem management; convert recurring issues to permanent fixes.

Scope: a complete incident & problem management runbook for M365 + Azure — severity matrix, roles, triage, per-workload diagnostic playbooks, Service Health, client comms, Microsoft escalation, RCA, and the convert-to-permanent-fix loop. White-label.
pricing: T3 (advanced) — cross-workload runbook + process + automation.
